facts.address: 11480 North Torrey Pines Road, La Jolla, CA 92037
bookingFacts: Tee times are released online at 7:00 PM every day.
City of San Diego residents with a valid Resident ID Card can book 0 to 7 days ahead with no booking fee.
Residents can book 8 to 90 days ahead for a $32 non-refundable booking fee per player.
Non-residents can book 0 to 90 days ahead for a $50 non-refundable, non-transferable booking fee per player.
The booking fee is charged per player per tee time and does not count toward green fees. Green fees are paid on the day of play.
Each reservation holder is limited to two tee times a day, for up to eight players.
All tee times are quoted at the non-resident rate. Show a valid Resident ID Card at check-in to get the resident rate.
Tee times are non-transferable and cannot be rescheduled. The player of record must be present and play.
Check in at least 30 minutes before your tee time or you risk losing it.
No tee time? You can join a virtual waitlist on the day of play once you are at the course. Names are called in order as cancellations and no-shows open up.
To qualify for a Resident ID Card you must live in or own a residence in the City of San Diego. The city sells and renews the card online.
